issues.description: Method SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice: The problem statement (UML and notes) requires calculateTotalPrice to be static (problem_statement.md lines 77-81), but the provided solution implements it as an instance method (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/SealSaloon.java: declaration at line 57). The starter/example Main code also calls it as an instance method (template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java lines 13-14: shop.calculateTotalPrice(...)). This contradiction (static vs instance) leaves students unclear whether they must implement calculateTotalPrice as static or instance-level and whether to call it via an instance or the class, which can lead to incorrect implementations or confusing grading criteria.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the intent consistent across artifacts. Preferred fix: update the problem statement (UML and the 'Note that the following methods and attributes must be static' section) to NOT require calculateTotalPrice to be static, since the example Main and the solution implement and call it as an instance method. Alternatively, if you intend calculateTotalPrice to be static, change the solution and example usage to declare it static (public static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal)) and update calls to use SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(meal). Ensure the UML, textual notes, and example code all match the chosen approach.
